title: USA CND
descriptionHtml:
A CND sign Americanised with two stars and thirteen stripes. The "peace sign" was originally the symbol of the UK Campaign for Nuclear Disarmament. It was designed by Gerald Holtom in 1958. The symbol consists of the semaphore letters "N" and "D" (for "nuclear disarmament") inside a circle. The original colors were white on black.

EDITION OF 100

3 COLOUR SCREENPRINT 

482mm X 482mm

title: Nin
descriptionHtml:
This is one of three pictures that I originally drew on postcards to send to friends; they are reproduced here using foil stamping which is made using a silver foil and a heated stamp of the image. It's very shiny...

Nin is the word for the ash tree in Old Irish.


Paper size: 165mm x 230mm

Image size: 130mm x 180mm

Printed on acid-free archival 270gsm GF Smith Colorplan

From an edition of 250

title: Winter Smeuse
descriptionHtml:
SMEUSE

YOU MIGHT NOT KNOW WHAT A SMEUSE IS; I DIDN’T, UNTIL THIS SUMMER WHEN I WAS SENT THE MANUSCRIPT FOR ROBERT MACFARLANE’S FORTHCOMING BOOK LANDMARKS. IN THE BOOK HE HAS PREPARED A NUMBER OF GLOSSARIES OF WORDS WHICH YOU WOULD STRUGGLE TO FIND IN A STANDARD DICTIONARY. THEY ARE WORDS FROM DIALECT, SLANG AND SO ON, AND DESCRIBE MATTERS LOOSELY PERTAINING TO THE LAND. FOR INSTANCE, AN OLD ESSEX DIALECT TERM FOR A KESTREL IS ‘WIND-FUCKER’. AN OLD SUSSEX WORD FOR THE GAP AT THE BOTTOM OF A HEDGE MADE BY THE REGULAR PASSAGE OF A SMALL ANIMAL IS… SMEUSE.
THIS PRINT IS AN ADAPTATION OF THE LINOCUT WORK I DID FOR THE COVER OF LANDMARKS.
EDITION OF 88 PRINTS
2 COLOUR SCREEN PRINT
PAPER SIZE: 530MM X 375MM
PRINT SIZE: 385MM X 265MM APPROX.
PRINTED ON 300GSM ACID-FREE ARCHIVAL SOMERSET SATIN

title: Moon Road
descriptionHtml:
This was originally made as a linocut which was hand-printed in the artist's kitchen as a part of the development process towards making the artwork for the cover of Robert Macfarlane's 2013 book 'The Old Ways'. As ever, the eventual cover artwork bore no relation to the early ideas, but this print was the happy, if unexpected outcome.

3 colour screen print
Paper size 500mm x 375mm
Print size 370mm x 260mm
Edition of 88
